mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.bug_no, b.case_id, b.project_id, b.module, b.title, b.description, b.reproduce_steps, b.expected_result, b.actual_result, b.environment, b.affected_version, b.bug_type, b.attachment, b.severity, b.bug_priority, b.status, b.reporter, b.assignee, b.create_time, b.update_time, tc.title AS case_title, tc.case_no AS case_no FROM bug b LEFT JOIN test_case tc ON b.case_id = tc.id WHERE b.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY b.id ASC

SELECT b.id, b.bug_no, b.case_id, b.project_id, b.module, b.title, b.description, b.reproduce_steps, b.expected_result, b.actual_result, b.environment, b.affected_version, b.bug_type, b.attachment, b.severity, b.bug_priority, b.status, b.reporter, b.assignee, b.create_time, b.update_time, tc.title AS case_title, tc.case_no AS case_no FROM bug b LEFT JOIN test_case tc ON b.case_id = tc.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
